fact: UNICEF reports that a digital birth and death registration mobile application is used at NCRA registration centres located in hospitals such as Ola During Hospital, Freetown: the birth record is entered there, transferred to the Central Registry System and passed through the central server to generate the identification number, with the certificate ready within 24 hours; over 200 babies a month are registered at Ola During.
title: Making birth registration more accessible for every child in Sierra Leone
